text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love, returning this to you. An 
"inflation" of culture and history, 
"delight" had formed a "BEC."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that history book...! I have the exact 
same one! I've already re-read it dozens 
of times—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Is that true...? To think I would meet a 
kindred spirit..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! Uni-san, do you have a favorite 
chapter... or anything like that...!?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Chapter 2: 'The Rise of the Renaissance.' 
It has the "Hadron Shower," and I "love" 
it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The Renaissance represents the golden age 
of European literature. That single page 
of history connecting to modern literature 
is a treasure trove of stylized beauty...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I completely agree...! Coupled with the 
background of classical culture reviving 
after ten centuries, it truly was an era 
packed with romance.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...It's the "sharing" of "fun." The 
"hadron shower" exists here too.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—Ah. My apologies. I got carried away in 
the heat of the moment...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Me too... but I never expected we'd get to 
talk about this book. Um... if it's okay 
with you, would you like to chat more 
about it after this...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Books are wonderful, aren't they? 
...They've given me so many more moments 
of joy and happiness.
